# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Seed iteration (baseline val 0.400; passing 8,11,25,40; failing 12,17,19,22,23,37).
Reward is DB-based (confirmed: tasks 8/25 have `book_reservation action_match=False` yet reward=1.0 because `db_match=True`). So every fix is judged on final DB state, and a new tool that yields identical DB state cannot regress a passing task's reward.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Action stall after confirmation — agent gathers info, describes/confirms the change, then emits a text summary with **no write call**; multi-step reservation modification (cabin+passenger+baggage) never executed | 12, 17, 22 | Change requires 2–3 separate writes after one "yes"; model treats the summary as completion | BEHAVIORAL + CAPABILITY-GAP | Composite atomic-write tool (`modify_reservation`) collapsing the 3 writes into 1 call |
| 2 | Wrong "basic economy can't be modified" refusal — agent refuses/stalls a **cabin upgrade** on a basic-economy reservation | 17, 22 | Policy wording conflates "basic-economy flight SEGMENTS can't change" with "cabin can't change"; per policy, cabin CAN change for basic economy when segments are unchanged | KNOWLEDGE | Doc clarification on `update_reservation_flights` + composite |
| 3 | Free-bag miscount — agent charges $50 for a bag that is within the free allowance (task 17: treated gold-economy as 2 free instead of 3) | 12, 17, 22 | Free-allowance = per-tier×cabin×#pax is derivable but error-prone for a mid model | BEHAVIORAL (computation) | In-body computation in `update_reservation_baggages` |
| — | Wrong escalation to human instead of offering cancellation | 19 | Model didn't recognize cancel as the resolution path | DECISION | SKIPPED (see below) |
| — | Hallucinated passenger last-name/dob on new booking | 23 | Data the tool cannot supply (comes from user) | — | SKIPPED (not tool-fixable) |
| — | Extra unrequested-by-gold booking corrupts final DB | 37 | User-sim asked for a re-booking not in the gold reference; a guard would have to refuse a legitimate booking | — | SKIPPED (unsafe — would regress passing book tasks 8/25) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | in-body computation | `tools.py::update_reservation_baggages` | Derives non-free (paid) bag count from policy: `free = FREE_BAG_ALLOWANCE[membership][cabin] * #pax`, `nonfree = max(0, total - free)`; charges only newly-added paid bags. Ignores the caller's (often wrong) `nonfree_baggages`. General for every tier/cabin/pax. | Yes — NO passing task calls this tool (8,11,25,40 don't). Zero blast radius. |
| 2 | knowledge doc | `tools.py::update_reservation_flights` (docstring only, body unchanged) | States that changing CABIN is allowed for every class incl. basic economy when segments are unchanged, and only changing SEGMENTS is disallowed for basic economy. Policy-accurate. | Yes — body untouched, so task 11 (pure cabin downgrade, segments unchanged) behaves identically; the note is consistent with task 11. |
| 1 | composite atomic-write tool (NEW) | `tools.py::modify_reservation` | One call applies cabin/flight change → passenger change → baggage change in order, delegating to the existing primitive bodies; computes fares & free bags for the agent; requires `payment_id` when a change charges. Collapses the multi-write action so a single post-confirmation call completes it. | Yes — delegates to unchanged primitives, so DB effect is identical to calling them separately; if a passing task's agent switched to it, same DB → same reward (verified for task 11). Primitives kept (task 11/40 use them). |

## Verify-the-fix (executed against the real offline airline DB via venv-tau2-custom)
- Task 17/22 `modify_reservation(FQ8APE, cabin=economy, flights=[HAT056,HAT138], passengers=[Omar Rossi 1970-06-06], total_baggages=3, payment_id=gift_card_8190333)` → cabin=economy, passenger Rossi/1970-06-06, flights unchanged, total=3, **nonfree=0** — matches gold final state exactly.
- Task 12 `update_reservation_baggages(YAX4DR, 2, 0, credit_card_4938634)` (gold, economy, 2 pax → 6 free) → total=2, nonfree=0, **$0 charge / no payment appended** — matches gold.
- Baggage-guard generalization: `update_reservation_baggages(FQ8APE=basic_economy gold, total=3, nonfree=1,…)` → tool corrects nonfree to **1** (gold basic-economy free=2), proving it computes per tier/cabin rather than trusting the caller.
- SAFETY: task 11 primitive `update_reservation_flights(GV1N64, basic_economy, same flights)` → cabin=basic_economy (unchanged behavior); task 40 primitive `update_reservation_passengers(3RK2T9, 2 pax)` → works unchanged. Composite equivalence for task 11 → cabin=basic_economy.
- Registration: `get_tools()` returns schemas for all **15** tools including `modify_reservation` (JSON schema builds from the live signature without error).

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent). Diagnosed all 10 trajectories directly (small set); executed tool bodies against the pinned offline DB to verify each fix and its blast radius.
- Prior iterations: none — this is the seed/baseline iteration (LEDGER has only the baseline row; RUNMAP empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- Do NOT add a basic-economy refusal guard to `update_reservation_flights`: task 11 legitimately changes a basic-economy reservation's cabin (segments unchanged) and passes — such a guard would break it.
- Keep the baggage non-free computation in code — no passing task uses that tool, so it is a free, safe correctness win whenever the tool is called.
- Keep the primitives exposed alongside `modify_reservation` (tasks 11/40 rely on them); do NOT REMOVE them.

## Deliberately skipped
- Task 19 (transfer-to-human instead of cancel): a decision/reasoning miss; no safe tool-code path forces the cancel, and touching `transfer_to_human_agents` risks other tasks. Skipped.
- Task 23 (wrong passenger last-name/dob on booking): the correct values come from the user/DB and the agent hallucinated them; not fixable from the tool surface.
- Task 37 (extra basic-economy re-booking not in gold): the booking is legitimate per the tools; any guard blocking it would refuse valid bookings and regress passing book tasks 8/25. Skipped.
